title: Central Texas Home Pricing: What Most Agents Never Show You
description:
Find out what your home could actually net before you list. Take the free Pre-Sale Profit Map: https://realestatesteph.co/pre-sale-profit-map/

Buying or Selling a Home ANYWHERE in Texas? Let's Talk! We Can Help. https://calendly.com/realestatestephen/30min?month=2024-07
Most home sellers in Central Texas pick a list price from a Zillow estimate, a neighbor's sale, or the agent who says the biggest number. None of those show you the math, and in this market a pricing mistake costs real money.
This video walks through the full home pricing strategy Stephen Harris uses across 400-plus closings in Killeen, Fort Hood, Georgetown, Round Rock, and Pflugerville: how comparable sales actually work, how adjustments move the number for your specific home, and the four pricing tiers every seller should see before committing to a price. Most agents give you one number. This shows you all four, with what you'd actually walk away with at each.
The core idea: a lower list price is not a lower sale price. Pricing where buyers compete creates leverage, and leverage protects your net proceeds.
